note: Build 16 plus one piece, approved by the owner as a design on 26 November (R668): whole channels, playlists and profiles downloaded and transcribed without watching over them. Before a capture: the count, the hours, the disk needed against the disk free, and the quality (Best available, Up to 720p, Up to 1080p, Audio only; a ready-made file without Video tools).
